'''Jeelvic''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Jawa/Legends|Jawa]] merchant who living during the [[Galactic War]]. He operated near the wreckage of the ''[[Stardream]]'' in the [[Dune Sea/Legends|Dune Sea]] at the start of the [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] [[rakghoul pandemic]]. Later, he would wander into the [[rakghoul tunnels]] during subsequent outbreaks of the [[Rakghoul plague/Legends|rakghoul plague]] on [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]], Tatooine, and [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]].
